name: com.firstsymbol.lettera
description: Text engine for Unity UI and world space: full OpenType shaping (HarfBuzz), bidirectional text, Unicode line breaking, system fonts and fallback, color emoji, a shared SDF atlas, and styles driven by extensible markup, formulas in the text's flow, and solid lit 3D text.

samples.description: A guided session per device for what only a real phone can answer: one screen a step, Pass, Fail or Skip, and one text block to send back. Lettera > Device Check builds it with every native route on.
A Canvas built from code: mixed scripts, emoji, tags, wrapping, eliding, auto size and runtime text, with no fonts in the project.
Fields built from code: a chat box, a checked e-mail field, a password, a rich text area with shortcuts, a dropdown and selectable text.
Built from code: every motion, a typewriter, a ticker, a link, a spoiler, a hover rule and an inline sprite.
Built from code: a very long document in a scrolling view, searched and jumped through.
Formulas in a sentence and by themselves, every construct with its source, a field that shows what is typed.
A line per edge shape, each look, a counter, a formula, 500 shared labels, and solid text in a Canvas by a render texture.
